bhattānumodana.p: [Bhatta+anumodana] (thī,na) CL=9 Causing to rejoice in alms giving; Preaching the Dhamma with regard to alms-food donation, rejoicing in the alms-food.
a: ဘတ္တာနုမောဒန(ထီ၊န)
